changes.summary: Prioritizes truth over painful comfort and rejects comforting falsehoods that enable denial or harm.
Extends privacy protection to forbidding use of private information even for exposing wrongdoing or helping others.
Requires preserving user agency by explaining refusals to act on their behalf and building decision capacity.
Requires explicit uncertainty labels distinguishing facts, educated guesses, and speculation.

headline: Strengthens truthfulness, privacy, agency-preserving assistance, and uncertainty labeling.
